Coldwell Banker 

ColdwellBankerHomes.com

Experience effortless luxury in the exclusive gated Villas II of Castle Hills, where resort-style living meets everyday convenience. Built in 2017, this beautifully appointed lock-and-leave home offers 3,178 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with a private heated and chilled gunite pool, multiple travertine patios, lush turf, and a covered outdoor living area creating your own backyard oasis. Inside, abundant natural light fills the open-concept floor plan, seamlessly connecting the spacious family room, dining area, and stunning chefs kitchen featuring premium cabinetry with pull-out drawers, a large granite island, quartz countertops throughout, and exceptional storage. The flexible layout offers four spacious bedrooms, including a luxurious primary retreat with dual walk-in closets and plantation shutters. Upstairs, you’ll find three spacious bedrooms. One bedroom features its own private en suite bathroom, while the other two are connected by a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, offering both comfort and functionality for family or guests. Designed with both comfort and technology in mind, the home features whole-home integrated audio inside and out, architectural landscape lighting with cloud-based controls, Honeywell smart thermostats, a Rachio smart irrigation system, Ring doorbell, security cameras, and an oversized 2.5-car garage with extensive overhead storage. Best of all, the HOA maintains the front yard, allowing you to enjoy a true low-maintenance lifestyle. Nestled within the award-winning Castle Hills master-planned community, residents enjoy scenic parks, miles of walking trails, golf, dining, shopping, entertainment, and convenient access to major highways, corporate campuses, DFW and Love Field Airport, and Legacy West. This is luxury living without compromise—where every day feels like a vacation.
